title: Little Wolf and the Glowing Shell
moral: Be brave, listen carefully, and ask for help when needed.

scenes.summary: Little Wolf sets out to find a glowing shell he saw in a dream.
scenes.text: Little Wolf woke by the shore and decided to find a glowing shell he had seen in a dream. A fish guided him along a pebble path.
scenes.image_prompt: little wolf walking along beach following glowing pebbles cartoon

scenes.summary: He gets lost in tall sea grass and feels unsure.
scenes.text: While swimming, Little Wolf reached tall sea grass and felt lost. The path disappeared and he did not know where to go.
scenes.image_prompt: little wolf surrounded by tall sea grass underwater looking confused cartoon

scenes.summary: He listens carefully and follows a sound to a glowing cave.
scenes.text: Little Wolf listened closely and followed a soft bell sound. With the turtle’s help, he found a glowing cave filled with light.
scenes.image_prompt: wolf and turtle entering glowing underwater cave with jellyfish lights cartoon

scenes.summary: He finds the glowing shell inside the cave.
scenes.text: Inside the cave, Little Wolf found the glowing shell resting on a pearl. He picked it up and felt brave and happy.
scenes.image_prompt: little wolf holding glowing shell inside cave magical underwater cartoon

scenes.summary: He returns safely home with help from friends.
scenes.text: Little Wolf returned to the shore with help from a seal. He felt safe, happy, and proud of his adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: seal helping little wolf reach shore sunset beach cartoon

story: Little Wolf wanted to find a glowing shell he saw in a dream. A fish guided him along a pebble path into the sea. While swimming, he got lost in tall sea grass but stayed calm. He listened carefully and followed a soft sound to a glowing cave. Inside, he found the shell and felt brave. With help from friends, he returned safely home, feeling happy and proud.
